Signs of the World

Traffic signal ahead

History

The 1935 first edition of the US Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) established the three-color traffic signal as the standard. The 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals recommends a symbol of the three-color traffic light, shown in its own colors.

Adoption

The three-color signal is a warning sign recognized around the world, set in both diamonds and triangles. Japan is the standout, turning the lights on their side.
